changes: Menus and buttons now use text, with a single decorative game icon in the private Bot status panel.
Bot updates now use this channel's identity and keep working when its name changes.
Banner and daily challenge deliveries now run independently, so an error in one feed does not pause the other.
Private feed diagnostics show the configured destination, source status and recent confirmed delivery.
Global chat now rechecks its settings before pausing or resuming, preventing outdated controls from changing a newer configuration.
Relevant bot updates will be posted here. Setup confirmations and diagnostic reports remain private.
